title: 有馬記念の後に・最後のキーワード

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Victory at the Arima Kinen! Gold Ship has conquered the mountain of rivalry and taken the summit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the final clue in hand, she stands ready to open up the path to the promised Eden.
